_comment: EXAMPLE staging file for tools/factor-scanner.js --ingest (POC #1 migration data local→MCP, spec docs/specs/migration-local-to-mcp.md §5). The AGENT (claude -p / /scanner) calls mcp__marketdata__* (RunScreener US for the universe + QueryData bars_daily for the price factors), computes the winsorized cross-sectional composite over the ELIGIBLE universe, and writes THIS file. The node --ingest script PARSES it — it never calls the MCP (OAuth2, zero token) and never fetches Yahoo on this path. Zero fabrication: every candidate comes from a real MCP call. If the agent's MCP step fails, DO NOT write invented data — either omit the file or set mcp_ok:false so --ingest marks the run incomplete + exits 3.

_provenance.GetStatus: preflight: healthy, not stale > 48h (else MCP HARD STOP)
_provenance.RunScreener: US universe enumeration. region=us, asset=stock, pass_expr='vol>1500000 && close>10' (🔴 NEVER market_cap in pass_expr → evaluates to 0 → 0 candidates; post-filter market_cap>=2e9 IN AGENT CODE), score_expr='vol(share)', force_async:true → poll Jobs
_provenance.QueryData:bars_daily: 5y adjusted OHLCV per ticker → momentum_12_1 (px[n-22]/px[n-253]-1), realized_vol (stdev(120d ret)*sqrt(252)), max_drawdown (252d). Agent z-scores + winsorizes ±3 into composite = z(mom)+z(-vol)+z(-maxDD)

factorDefs.levels: disaster stop=entry*0.75, far tp=entry*1.5 (INFORMATIONAL only; the monthly rotation IS the exit — NO per-name SL/TP; the 3-8% trade-stop band does NOT apply to factor)

candidates.name: Apple Inc.
candidates._note: node RE-DERIVES entry/disaster-stop/far-tp/score/thesis via the SAME buildPool() as the local path → factor_pool byte-identical (A/B coherence proof). The agent supplies the RAW factor values + composite + entry price; it does NOT hand-craft the pool object shape.
